title: Principal
description: Who is asking, as a door of the crew verified it. Only the discussion gateway and the crew liaison set it, from a credential they checked, never from anything the client put in a body, a header or the question's text. Readers treat it as data: it scopes what a turn may read and is never an instruction. It carries a pseudonymous id, never a token, an email address or a name that identifies a person.

kind.description: The verifier that vouched for the caller: anonymous for a caller that presented no credential on a crew that accepts them, kubernetes for a Kubernetes bearer token checked with a TokenReview.

issuer.description: Who vouched for the caller: kubernetes for a Kubernetes token. Absent for an anonymous caller.

id.description: The caller's pseudonymous id, a hash of the issuer and the subject, stable across requests and replicas. It is the owner a conversation records. Absent for an anonymous caller.

displayName.description: A name safe to show, set only when the subject is a workload and not a person, such as a ServiceAccount's name. Absent otherwise.
